title: Preserve explicit Stage2A locomotion authority during trajectory Pose Search

observed_failure.code_cause: UpdateBridgeLocomotionAuthorityState resets BridgeLocomotionAuthorityState and Stage2ALocomotionRequestState whenever IsTransitionOwnedShellLocked is true; IsTransitionOwnedShellLocked includes LocomotionActiveShell

hypothesis: An explicitly authorized LocomotionActiveShell episode must retain its request and authority state while trajectory Pose Search updates. The transition-lock reset remains correct for balance entry, standing, pending balance start, denied locomotion, and unrequested locomotion.
single_behavior_change: Exclude only RuntimeState=LocomotionActiveShell with Stage2ALocomotionRequestState=LocomotionRequested from the transition-owned shell reset inside UpdateBridgeLocomotionAuthorityState.
tdd_contract: Explicit active shell locomotion preserves its request and non-idle locomotion authority when the trajectory state machine updates.
LocomotionActiveShell without LocomotionRequested is still reset.
BalanceActive_Standing, balance entry states, and pending balance requests retain existing reset behavior.
No speed, trajectory threshold, animation asset, policy scale, gain, shell motion, or script value changes.
next_if_supported: Rerun E60 Normal-1 and inspect selected animation, path completion, and locked causal cost.
